name: ypng-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for local-first Jira tracking, product-management judgment, and codebase-derived Confluence documentation

plugins.name: jira3
plugins.description: Local-first Jira tracking: task files are the source of truth; detached hooks mirror them to Jira with zero model cost. Done requires human approval.

plugins.name: handbook
plugins.description: Non-technical product docs in Confluence, derived from the codebase: page files in the repo are the source of truth; a zero-dependency CLI mirrors them via detached hooks. Git-derived staleness detection; an audience gate blocks jargon, code, secrets, and unverified claims from publishing.

plugins.name: product-brain
plugins.description: Gives Claude the context-awareness and judgment of a seasoned product manager. Calibrates decisions to the product's real stage and usage, evaluates proposals against purpose and priorities, and pushes back on speculative or mistimed work.
